text: Kusum Harish Dharamshi is worth calling first because she has cash in hand of ₹468.85 Cr from the HD Fire Protect Limited IPO, where she was a Promoter Selling Shareholder. That money has been in hand since 25 days ago, when the offer listed. She also keeps 13,939,200 shares that are locked in, so more money can follow later. The filing notes a family link with Harish Narshi Dharamshi. Confidence is medium, and the listing notice has not yet been seen.
